# Overview of FundedNext:
## FundedNext - For Every Trader, Every Market | Best Trading Firm

FundedNext offers the best prop firm challenge accounts, where traders can trade with up to $300k simulated funds and the best conditions.

> "FundedNext is a leading prop trading firm committed to providing unparalleled opportunities and resources for traders to excel in the financial market. Our team of industry veterans, financial experts, and technology enthusiasts works tirelessly to deliver innovative solutions that push boundaries and set benchmarks in the trading world.”

FundedNext currently offers two distinct markets for traders: FundedNext CFDs and FundedNext Futures.

## FundedNext Markets:
1. FundedNext CFDs
2. FundedNext Futures

These are the two core trading models offered under the FundedNext brand. Each model represents a distinct trading experience tailored to different asset classes.

## Market - FundedNext CFDs:
Within the FundedNext CFDs market, traders can choose between two funding models: Stellar Challenge and Stellar Instant.

- [**Stellar Challenge**](https://fundednext.com/stellar-model):  
  The Stellar Challenge includes three sub-models:  
  • Stellar Step 1 – Available in: $6K, $15K, $25K, $50K, $100K, $200K
  • Stellar Step 2 – Available in: $6K, $15K, $25K, $50K, $100K, $200K
  • Stellar Lite – Available in: $5K, $10K, $25K, $50K, $100K, $200K

- [**Stellar Instant**](https://fundednext.com/stellar-instant):  
  This model offers immediate access to funded accounts without going through evaluation phases. Only one model is available under this category: Stellar Instant.
Stellar Instant – Available in: $2K, $5K, $10K, $20K

## Market - FundedNext Futures:

FundedNext Futures is a separate market designed for futures traders. It offers two funding models: Rapid Challenge and Legacy Challenge.
 • Rapid Challenge – Available in: $25K, $50K, $100K
 • Legacy Challenge – Available in: $25K, $50K, $100K

## Additional Note:
FundedNext is committed to evolving its offerings and frequently updates its models and features based on trader needs and market trends. Stay tuned for future model enhancements and expanded account options.

## Project Details:
The FundedNext platform is designed to cater to both beginner and expert traders. The project aims to provide seamless access to the markets with no extra fees or hidden rules. Key components of this initiative include:

- **Timeline**: Ongoing updates to account models and platform features.
- **Goals**: Enhance user experience, expand market reach, and increase trader satisfaction.
- **Future Plans**: Rollout of new models and funding options based on trader feedback.
